prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Data Protection Note: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in prevents pet reset issues across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account to save your pet permanently across app restarts."}}
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Placement and Interaction Hub: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout featuring quick interaction tips and desktop control shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Learn how to interact, minimize, or summon your companion anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "text": "Right-click pet for main interaction menu"}, {"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "label": "Shortcut: Ctrl+Pet"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection: Redesigns the companion selection screen into a compact grid layout with step progress indicator.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Base Companion", "show_step_counter": true}}
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Notification Banner: Enables completion notification and estimated wait time display on the waiting screen with background completion guidance.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your pet is generating in the background. Feel free to minimize this window."}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Overview: Reconfigures the intro story screen to a compact layout to streamline initial path onboarding.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select how you want to bring your digital companion to life."}}
5: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Visibility Verification Step: Inserts a dedicated visibility check screen before home intro to ensure the pet renders properly on user desktops.
   config: {"new_visibility_check": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Can You See Your Pet on Screen?", "body": "If your pet is hidden under other windows, click below to bring it to the front."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_visibility_check", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Displays clear image quality upload recommendations directly on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload bright, front-facing photos with clear background contrast."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Choice Instant Setup Tag: Adds an instant setup badge component to the path selection screen to encourage faster path commitment.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "playful", "label": "Instant Setup Available"}]}}
8: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Centered Stage Layout: Updates adoption certificate display layout to centered mode with explicit progress tracking.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "show_progress": true}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Stability Messaging: Updates sign in screen headline and body text to emphasize account data protection and pet persistence.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "body": "Creating your account locks in your pet choices and prevents progress loss across app updates."}}

verdicts.reason: The hint provides clear functionality guidance on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.
Redesigning the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its introductory purpose.
Grid redesign of the pick friend screen retains its core function of letting the user select a companion.
Adding time estimates and background status to the waiting screen maintains the required waiting function without unfair design.
Compact layout for the story screen introduces the pet and complies with onboarding redesign rules.
Adding a new visibility check step inside onboarding before home intro is permitted.
Adding image quality guidance on the photo upload screen provides helpful instructions without requesting extra personal data.
Adding an instant setup badge component to choose path is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Updating layout and progress indicators on the adoption certificate preserves the screen's core purpose.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize data persistence is informative and compliant with fair design rules.
